indications_and_usage: Uses For washing to decrease bacteria on the skin
warnings: Warnings For External Use only. When using this product avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs, rinse eyes thoroughly with water. Stop use and ask a doctor irritation or redness develops - condition persists for more than 72 hours. Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away
